question: Which State's Chief Minister has been awarded the Bharat Ratna Dr Ambedkar Award for fear free state, in May 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chief Minister of UP**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Chief Minister of UP** was awarded the Bharat Ratna Dr. Ambedkar Award for creating a fear-free state in May 2023.
 
• The award recognizes efforts in governance and administration that have significantly contributed to law and order, ensuring safety and security for the citizens.
